correctness.rationale: For each rational input cell the welfare is an n-fold affine product; the optimizer has degree at most n−1. In any prescribed separated two-cluster sub-box the strict logarithmic derivative changes sign across (1/4,3/4) and gives a unique central optimum. Choosing n distinct roots of unity modulo a prime p≡1 (mod n), then a p² lift with e_(n−1) of exact p-adic valuation one, yields an integer product F with F′ ≡ nY^(n−1) (mod p) and constant term p-divisible but not p²-divisible. Eisenstein makes F′ irreducible over Q; all its critical roots are real by Rolle. Exact code checks 18 sample degrees n=3..20 and one independent explicit n=4 certificate, not the infinite theorem.
